chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Rifah ibn Musa said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about performing ablution (wudu) in the mosque, and he disliked it from excretion (al-gha'ith) and urination (al-bawl).
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing wudu or relieving oneself in the mosque according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the specific legal status of ritual purity acts within the sacred precincts of the mosque, distinguishing between the permissibility of using mosque water for ablution and the dislike (karahah) of relieving oneself there. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on maintaining the sanctity and cleanliness of mosques as places of divine worship, ensuring they remain free from impurities associated with excretion.
